purpose: Allow a later registered PV1 child to resume an already charged full checkpoint from a closed sibling without silently restarting or dropping optimizer, scheduler, RNG, sampler, processor or statistics state.
implemented_contract: The existing validator still requires same-campaign registered siblings, a closed source lease, terminal native jobs, no unknown or pending effects, an exact recipe, a complete checkpoint and an already charged sampler cursor.
Every source member is opened without following symlinks, streamed through a content-bound staging directory and checked against the sealed checkpoint manifest.
CHECKPOINT_COMPLETE.json is copied last; the exact member set is verified before a same-filesystem atomic rename exposes the destination.
An interrupted staging directory can continue only when every existing member has the expected hash; changed or unexpected members are preserved and rejected.
An already atomically exposed destination without a final receipt can be recovered only after exact member and native checked-resume validation.
The final readback reruns the original resume contract for recipe, sample cursor, manifest, statistics and full state before emitting a receipt.
The operation records zero additional optimizer updates and makes no campaign-ledger mutation.
remaining_gates: Complete and independently audit all actual B0 DEV48 conditions.
Close the B0 native child and recompute the full mandatory-work resource admission.
Register the matched A_CONTROL and B_COVERAGE cold children with exact source, data, recipe and output bindings.
Execute the copy only for an actual interrupted training continuation; fresh step-zero arms continue directly from the common CORR2048 parent.
Obtain current native permissions and a legal one-GPU PBS allocation before any model load or update.
